idle.rule: Stands still. The mark never loops when nothing is happening.

send.rule: Message sent, payment signed, first open: the whole light (gap 0, step 0) splits and is handed on a step.

listening.rule: Microphone open. The gap follows the real input level (0..1); in silence it rests at 2. No invented breathing.

thinking.rule: Waiting for an answer for more than 400 ms. The halves meet and part again. Stops on the first word with a snap spring.

speaking.rule: Voice playing. The step follows the voice envelope (0..1); pauses return it to 4.

send.rule: Both slits dip to 60 % for a moment and come back: the light was handed on.

idle.rule: Only while the companion is on screen: one slow breath, the way a lamp is never perfectly still.

listening.rule: The slits open with the voice it hears.

thinking.rule: The light is handed from one slit to the other, the relay of the symbol.

speaking.rule: The light follows its own voice. Never a glow, never a colour change.

reduced_motion: Every state holds the rest pose; the state is said in words (слухаю, думаю).
